facts.fact: The CBN Deputy Governor told the NITDA-CBN dialogue that financial institutions must comply with applicable data localisation requirements and a January 1, 2027 implementation timeline for critical payment transaction data.
facts.system: CBN data localisation requirement for critical payment transaction data

NGA.note: Protection of critical financial data is mentioned, with no data protection law stated.

facts.fact: NITDA says it and the Central Bank of Nigeria are advancing the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative, with the financial sector to be the first to comply and an assurance framework to guide implementation.
